reviews.review_description: It’s enjoyable enough, easy to pick up and has a good mix of challenge and entertainment. There’s definitely room for a little more polish and a few extra touches, such as the fuel cell you pick up could have definition and not just a red ball and maybe a proximity alarm as you get close to the tunnel wall.  But the foundations are solid and I’ve had a good time with it and at the price point worth a 4 star.
